Python with comments, verify comment count

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("\# This is a comment\n\# Another comment\ndef hello():\n    \# inline comment\n    pass\n", { 'comments' => true, 'language' => 'python' })
```
